title: Business idempotency key registry with unique constraints and payload hashes
objective: Each command and external observation type has a registered business key; a database unique constraint in the effect transaction rejects duplicates and detects key reuse with different content.
owner: Not assigned; proposed: Unbound platform architecture owner (role not staffed)

title: Transactional outbox with effect receipts and effect-free replay
objective: External effects are issued only from outbox items committed with the state change; each effect records a durable receipt; replay and rebuild code paths have no access to effect adapters.
implementing_systems: Unbound command engine and outbox (specified, not built)
residual_risks: Provider-side duplicates where rails lack idempotency
owner: Not assigned; proposed: Unbound platform architecture owner (role not staffed)

title: Serializable reservation with deterministic lock order
objective: Reservations are computed and inserted in one serializable transaction over authoritative records for the fund and all constrained ancestors, locking in a fixed order.
implementing_systems: Unbound grants and ledger components (specified, not built)
owner: Not assigned; proposed: Unbound platform architecture owner (role not staffed)

title: Dispatch fencing on hold version and authorization
objective: At the irreversible dispatch step, check the current hold publication version and authorization in the same transaction that releases the instruction; fail closed on unknown hold state.
owner: Not assigned; proposed: Unbound platform architecture owner (role not staffed)

title: Source feed completeness gate
objective: Accept external batches only when control totals match; detect missing deliveries against an expected calendar and hold dependent automation.
owner: Not assigned; proposed: Unbound platform architecture owner (role not staffed)

title: Continuous financial invariant monitor with release halt
objective: Evaluate ledger and payment invariants continuously and during ring deployment; breach halts rollout and opens an incident.

title: Concurrency, crash-injection and replay-equivalence test suite
objective: Deterministic interleavings, crash injection at every step of payment and posting flows, and replay-equivalence comparisons must pass before release.

title: Unknown state without retry affordance and evidence-gated resolution
objective: The payment model has an explicit Unknown state with no automatic or manual retry; NotReceived requires the rail's evidence combination and independent approval.
